fields.meta_title: Invoice Automation Software, Built From a Prompt | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Describe the invoices you get and the ones you send. Emergent builds invoice automation that reads vendor PDFs and bills your clients.
fields.h1: Build Invoice Automation That Reads Bills and Sends Invoices
fields.hero_description: Build invoice automation that codes the vendor PDFs you receive and drafts client invoices from logged hours.
fields.features_heading: What Invoice Automation Has to Handle
fields.features_subheading: The first three keep a bad bill out of your ledger. The other three carry invoice automation past the send button.
fields.feature_1:
Field extraction with a review queue

Each PDF or scan is read into vendor, invoice number, dates, PO number, and line items. A field the model is unsure of goes to a review queue, not straight to the ledger.
fields.feature_2:
Duplicate checks before anything posts

A resent PDF under a new filename is held, and the first copy stays the bill of record. The check compares number, amount and date against everything that vendor has billed before.
fields.feature_3:
GL coding line by line

GL accounts and cost centers come from how that vendor's lines were coded before. When finance codes a new item by hand, the app reuses that choice on the vendor's next invoice.
fields.feature_4:
Numbered and filed before sending

Outgoing invoices take the next number in your sequence, and no number is ever issued twice. Each invoice is saved as a PDF and a database row before anyone on the team sends it.
fields.feature_5:
Sent with a payment link

Customers get each invoice by email with a Stripe payment link, or one from the processor you connect. Until it is paid, the invoice stays on the dashboard's unpaid list.
fields.feature_6:
A codebase your engineer can extend

The app's code exports to your GitHub on paid plans. If a client wants its own invoice format or a second company joins the books, an engineer edits it there or you prompt Emergent.
fields.why_title: Why Build Invoice Automation With Emergent?
fields.why_description: Bills in and invoices out share one database in the app Emergent builds. A customer who also bills you is one record, not two.

fields.tab_content_1:
One bill record per PDF, with unsure fields held

Globex Industrial emails INV-20817 to the AP inbox at $3,412.50, and the due date sits under a smudge on the scan. That one field waits for Maria Lopez to confirm, and every other field is already filled.
fields.tab_content_2:
Five lines coded on arrival, one left for finance

On Initech Supply's INV-3381, five of six lines arrive coded like Initech's past bills. Shipping boxes go to 6100 Supplies and the forklift service to 6400 Repairs. The label printer, $240.00, has no history with this vendor. Sam Ortiz picks its account.
fields.tab_content_3:
Billable hours become client invoices on the 1st

Hours logged against each client in October turn into one draft invoice per client on Nov 1. Acme's draft comes to $6,300.00, for 42 hours at $150. Ana Ruiz reviews the four drafts in one list, and nothing goes out until she approves.
fields.tab_content_4:
The customer has the invoice before the van leaves

A technician closes the job on a phone, and the labor and parts on it become an invoice. Job 4471 bills 1.5 hours at $120 and a $68.40 shutoff valve, $248.40 in all. Dana Whitfield pays from her phone, and the PDF stays attached to the job record.

fields.howto_description: Seven steps to set up invoice automation that codes incoming bills and sends the invoices you issue.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Collect a month of real invoices
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Connect the inbox and your sources
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pull twenty invoices you received last month and five you sent. Include the hard ones, like a scan with a stamp across the total or a two-page PDF. These samples show Emergent what the app has to read and what your own invoices look like.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Tell Emergent what a finished bill record holds and which values a person must see before it posts, for example any total over $10,000 or a vendor seen for the first time. Anything that reads cleanly and stays under those limits goes straight through.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Connect the inbox vendors already email; nobody outside has to change a habit. For invoices you send, connect wherever billable work is recorded: a timesheet tool, a field service app, or Stripe orders. Emergent builds a sync for each one through its API.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Export last year's bills, with their GL accounts, from your accounting system and hand the file to Emergent. Regular vendors then start the first month with a coding history instead of an empty one.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Give Emergent your current invoice PDF and mark what should change, say a new logo or net 15 instead of net 30. Every invoice the app sends follows that template.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Bills you receive post with their GL codes and the source PDF attached. Invoices you send post as receivables under the customer's name, and your accountant closes the month in the same ledger as before.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send first, then switch the inbox
fields.howto_step_7_des: Turn on outgoing invoices for one billing cycle and check the month's total against the records you connected in step 3. Once the numbers agree, point the AP inbox at the app and let incoming bills follow.
